name: Andi

scaling.scaled: Cut the total volume by a third and choose loads that keep sets of 10+ alive in the opening rounds.
scaling.beginner: Halve the volume with light implements; long single-couplet grinds teach pacing fastest when the load is nearly trivial.

origin.summary: One of the newer Girls from CrossFit.com's expansion of the series — a high-volume single-couplet grind in the mold of the originals, built to be understood in one reading and remembered by lunchtime. Part of CrossFit's original 'Girls' benchmark series — named workouts introduced by founder Greg Glassman starting in 2003, on the logic that anything that leaves you flat on your back deserves a name like a storm. They serve as repeatable fitness tests: revisit one every few months and the clock tells you whether you're fitter. First posted to CrossFit.com on 2021-01-14.

description: 100 reps each of hang power snatch, push press, sumo deadlift high pull, and front squat at one fixed light barbell weight — a high-volume single-load barbell chipper.
source_notes: crossfit.com/faq/wod (official CrossFit FAQ, 'Explain The Workouts with Names (the Girls)?'), retrieved 2026-07-08
